title: Mark Walter’s TWG Says ‘There Has Been No Fraud’
summary: Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." TWG Global, the holding company at the heart of Mark Walter’s empire, defended itself against what it called “multipronged attacks” on its business as regulators and US prosecutors continue to probe the firm. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Unrivaled CEO Discusses New Funding, Expansion
summary: Alex Bazzell, CEO and co-founder Unrivaled, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Unrivaled, the 3-on-3 women’s basketball league founded by WNBA stars Breanna Stewart and Napheesa Collier. The league, founded in 2023, now has a valuation of $650 million, nearly doubling from September 2025. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Power, Infrastructure At Center of Data-Center Deals

title: Private Equity Firms Find a New Way to Ride Out Cash Crunch
summary: Bloomberg's Laura Benitez joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Private equity managers are using structured equity deals to placate investors frustrated by a lack of cash returns, as many firms struggle to exit investments and send money back to investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lots of PE 'Zombie' Investments: Jeffries' Greenberg

title: Permian Basin Set to Become Top US Gas Producer, Citi Says
summary: The Permian Basin is on track to become the largest US natural gas-producing region by the end of the decade, making the world’s most productive oil shale field also the nation’s leader in gas output, according to Citigroup Inc. analysts.

title: Data Center 'Backlash Is Very Real': Goodpaster
summary: Maria Goodpaster, partner at McKinsey & Company, Kate Dorsey, managing director at Stonepeak, and Melissa Kalka, M&A, private equity partner Kirkland & Ellis, join Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the increasing political and community pushback to growing construction of data centers. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Churn in Late Hours After Nvidia’s Results: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street traders sent stocks wavering in late hours after Nvidia Corp.’s earnings, with caution prevailing as bonds fell on bets the Federal Reserve will raise rates this year.

title: Colombian Central Bank Chief Warns of Damage From Soaring Peso
summary: Colombia’s central bank can do little to curb the soaring peso that’s putting exporters at a “tremendous disadvantage,” Governor Leonardo Villar said.

title: Victory Capital Agrees to Buy First Eagle For $7B
summary: Bloomberg's Loukia Gyftopoulou joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Victory Capital Holdings Inc. agreed to buy First Eagle Investments in a deal that would propel the combined firm’s assets under management to about $571 billion.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mexico Touts CDS Levels as Bonds Trade as Speculative Grade
summary: Mexico cited improving spreads in the credit-default swaps market as a sign of its good standing in debt markets, where investors have sent its bonds trading more in line with speculative-grade nations.

title: Buyers Circle Warner Assets Amid Paramount Legal Fight
summary: Bloomberg's Hannah Miller joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Paramount has acknowledged that it’s considering a wide range of options to settle lawsuits challenging its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oura Is Said to Seek Up to $3B in IPO
summary: Oura, a maker of smart rings that track health, fitness and sleep, and some of its backers are seeking to raise as much as $3 billion in a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: USD rises after PCE data, recoups half of buyback losses
summary: The dollar rose by the most in over two weeks, recovering about half of the losses triggered by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise move last week to prop up the bond market, as inflation data bolstered bets that the Federal Reserve will start raising interest rates by year end.

title: Bitcoin and Gold ETFs Draw $7 Billion as Scarcity Trade Surges
summary: Investors are no longer choosing between gold and Bitcoin as hedges against fiscal anxiety. They’re buying both.

title: Gold Rally Eases as Traders Turn Focus to Fed Interest Rate Path
summary: Gold retreated from a three-month high, with investors turning their focus to the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path ahead of the annual Jackson Hole gathering this week.

title: Nike on Pace for Worst Year Since Jordan’s 1993 Retirement
summary: When Michael Jordan quit pro basketball at just 30 years old, his exit created a headache for Nike Inc., the maker and massive beneficiary of his iconic line of sneakers.

title: US Stocks Finish Flat as Investors Prepare for Nvidia’s Earnings
